name: win-trigger-outreach-email
description: Prepares one Trigger Outreach Email to one person on one real public trigger, with why you and why now in your voice, a small easy ask, a voice check, and one follow-up at most, which you write and send yourself. Use for "run win-trigger-outreach-email", "write to someone who does not know me", "cold email without spam", "outreach on a trigger", "they just announced something, should I write", "first email to a stranger", "one follow-up only", part of the Claude Guide for Finding Clients Pack by 90n.
